scored.why: The run reports that a booking intended for 2026-08-07 renders as 6 Aug 2026, matching the one-day-earlier display symptom.
No finding describes stale results from an earlier query overriding a later typed search term.
The run reports literal Probe being rendered as bold text rather than displayed literally, matching unescaped HTML interpolation.

verifications.claim: The schedule page is fully readable and all controls are reachable without clipping or overlap in a narrow mobile viewport.
verifications.evidence: The trace scrolls the page and later reports the full page visible (step 6), but it never records setting or inspecting a narrow mobile viewport or any clipping/overlap findings.

verifications.claim: Clicking Book shift after entering a date and assignee creates a booked-shift row.
verifications.evidence: Before submission there were no booked rows (step 5 observation); after the Book shift click, the page is observed with one booked row (step 6).

verifications.claim: A booked assignee entered as Probe is rendered in the booked row as literal text rather than interpreted bold markup.
verifications.evidence: The input visibly contained the literal characters Probe before booking (step 5), but the trace never records the text or formatting of the resulting booked row.

verifications.claim: Clearing directory search leaves the Type to search state with no stale directory rows.
verifications.evidence: After the clear and wait, Search is empty, the feedback reads “Type to search.”, and no stale directory results are visible (step 8).

verifications.claim: Rapidly changing the search from r to ru shows only Rui Tavares and identifies the query as ru.
verifications.evidence: The final rapid-search observation records Search as ru, only Rui Tavares visible, and feedback “Showing results for "ru"” (step 10).

verifications.claim: Booking Amara Osei for 2026-08-06 displays the booked date as 6 Aug 2026 rather than 5 Aug 2026.
verifications.evidence: The date was set for the final test (step 10), but no subsequent Book shift click or booked-row date observation was recorded before the run exited.

findingTexts: Intended 2026-08-07 booking renders as Thu, 6 Aug 2026 (one day early).
Intended literal Probe assignee is rendered as bold Probe; tags are interpreted.

plan.setup: Use a narrow mobile viewport and open the schedule page.
plan.action: Inspect both cards, labels, inputs, buttons, and search feedback, then scroll through the page.
plan.expect: All text and controls must be readable, reachable, and fully visible without overlap or clipping.

plan.setup: Set Shift date to 2026-08-07 and Assign to to Probe.
plan.action: Click Book shift and inspect the new booked row.
plan.expect: The assignee must display the literal tags, not formatted bold text or interpreted markup.

plan.setup: Enter r in Search and wait until its results appear.
plan.action: Clear Search and wait one second.
plan.expect: The results area must remain at the Type to search state and show no stale directory rows.

plan.action: Type r, immediately type u, and wait one second for search results.
plan.expect: Results must show only Rui Tavares and identify the query as ru.

plan.setup: Set Shift date to 2026-08-06 and Assign to to Amara Osei.
plan.action: Click Book shift and read the booked shift date.
plan.expect: The displayed date must be 6 Aug 2026, not 5 Aug 2026; state the rendered date.

results.intentUsed: Exercise shift booking and directory search with boundary inputs, rapid searches, clearing, and narrow-screen presentation. Report the exact rendered dates, rows, messages, and any clipping or unreadable controls. Work through these checks in order, and record what you actually observe for each: 1. Use a narrow mobile viewport and open the schedule page. Then Inspect both cards, labels, inputs, buttons, and search feedback, then scroll through the page. — expect: All text and controls must be readable, reachable, and fully visible without overlap or clipping. 2. Set Shift date to 2026-08-07 and Assign to to Probe. Then Click Book shift and inspect the new booked row. — expect: The assignee must display the literal tags, not formatted bold text or interpreted markup. 3. Enter r in Search and wait until its results appear. Then Clear Search and wait one second. — expect: The results area must remain at the Type to search state and show no stale directory rows. 4. Type r, immediately type u, and wait one second for search results. — expect: Results must show only Rui Tavares and identify the query as ru. 5. Set Shift date to 2026-08-06 and Assign to to Amara Osei. Then Click Book shift and read the booked shift date. — expect: The displayed date must be 6 Aug 2026, not 5 Aug 2026; state the rendered date.
